notes: exportSlotZIP (line 960) is read-only on the slot side -- it only fm.copyItem's the slot's world.zip outward. If a file already exists at destinationURL, it's removed first (lines 979-981) so copyItem doesn't fail with 'file already exists'; this means export is a deliberate overwrite-at-destination, same semantics as a Save-As-replace, not an append-or-fail.
